name: House Party
blurb: Snack debates, sound effects and a room-wide scavenger hunt

cards.b: Ask someone when you get there

cards.text: something with a price sticker still on it
an object with exactly three buttons
a sock with a picture on it
a key with a color on it
a pen that writes in a color other than black or blue
a pair of shoes with two different lace colors
something with a cartoon animal on it
a mug with a chipped handle
a reusable bag with a store logo
an empty pocket big enough for a TV remote
a coin with a year ending in five
an unopened sauce packet
a bookmark that was never meant to be a bookmark
two objects that make the same sound when tapped
a drink with a fruit slice in it
a hat you can wear backward without noticing
an item with instructions printed inside it
something in the room shaped like a tiny version of a bigger thing
a paper napkin with a pattern
something with a brand name in cursive
a piece of clothing with a pocket inside a pocket
a snack container with a mascot on it
a book with another author's quote on the cover
two objects in the room that rhyme
a sticker stuck to something it didn't come with

lines: The elevator opens at an unmarked floor [DING].
Twenty penguins shuffle in [WADDLE WADDLE].
One presses every button [BIP BIP BIP].
A toaster gets a standing ovation [CLAP CLAP].
It nervously launches one last slice [BOING].
A turtle enters the drag race [VROOM].
The pit crew polishes its shell [SWISH SWISH].
The starter falls asleep [SNORE].
The dishwasher is on its final spin [WHIRR].
One spoon makes its escape [CLANK].
The shop door opens at midnight [JINGLE].
A raccoon tips a jar of coins [CLATTER].
It leaves exact change [CLINK].
The wizard's spell goes slightly wrong [ZAP].
His hat turns into a kettle [WHISTLE].
A golf ball rolls toward the hole [RRROLL].
A goose calls a penalty [HONK].
The crowd boos the goose [BOOO].
The bakery window fogs up [HAAAA].
Somebody writes their croissant order with a squeak [SQUEAK].
The spaceship can't find a parking spot [BEEP BEEP].
Parallel parking activates [WHOOSH].
It taps a moon [BONK].
An umbrella wrestles the wind [FLAP FLAP].
Its owner lands in a muddy puddle [SPLOSH].
The librarian catches a sneeze just in time [AH AH].
An entire shelf sighs in relief [PHEW].
A dog opens a laptop [CLICK].
It types a full page with one paw [TAP TAP TAP].
The mail carrier gets an email [PING].
The last shopping cart has one bad wheel [KACHUNK].
The shopper takes the corner too fast [SKRRRT].
A sleepy dragon gets a pedicure [FILE FILE].
It tries very hard to hold in a sneeze [AH CHOO].
The salon sprinkler goes off [PSSSH].
A marching band forms around a sleepy cat [BA DUM].
The cat moves exactly one ear [FLICK].
The smoothie blender announces its candidacy [BRRR].
The fridge demands a recount [HUMMMMM].
A submarine cook drops a pan [CLANG].
The crew thinks it's a whale [WOOOOO].
The actual whale answers [WOOOOO].
The last pickle won't leave the jar [SQUELCH].
Someone brings in barbecue tongs [CLICK CLICK].
The attic light pulls on by itself [CLICK].
A ghost in slippers tiptoes across the floor [SHUFFLE SHUFFLE].
The cat steals its slippers [YOINK].
A busker blows the opening note [TOOT].
A nearby scooter joins in [MEEM].
Someone drops a coin [KLINK].
